footer.about: Guesthouses, B&Bs and mountain cabins across Lebanon, booked straight from the people who run them.

home.title: Lebanon's guesthouses, booked direct.
home.subtitle: Stone houses in the Chouf, sea-view rooms in Batroun, cabins under the cedars. Book with the host, pay them directly, and keep the commission in Lebanon.
home.empty: The first hosts are joining now. Check back soon.
home.directTitle: Booking direct is simpler than you think
home.directBody: You talk to the people whose home it is. They see your request instantly and the room is held for you while they confirm.

noFees.title: No booking fees
noFees.body: Prices are the host's own. Nothing is added on top, for you or for them.

held.title: Your room is held
held.body: The moment you request dates, nobody else can take them while the host confirms.

deposit.title: Pay the way you already do
deposit.body: Whish, OMT, a bank transfer or cash. The host confirms once your deposit arrives.

concierge.title: Describe the weekend. We'll find the place.
concierge.body: Tell our concierge what you imagine, in English, Arabic or Arabizi. It only suggests places that are really free on your dates.
concierge.sampleQuestion: Quiet mountain weekend for two, hiking nearby, under $120 a night, 7 to 9 November
concierge.sampleAnswer: Three places are free those nights. Beit Ghazir in Ehden is closest to the trails, at $95 a night.

sign-up.title: Create your account
sign-up.subtitle: Save places, keep your trips in one place, or list your own.

host.title: List your place
host.headline: Your guests, your bookings. No commission.
host.intro: One calendar that stays in sync with Airbnb and Booking.com, a booking page for your Instagram bio, and a database that makes double bookings impossible.

sync.title: Synced with the platforms
sync.body: Paste your Airbnb and Booking.com calendar links. We keep every room in step, both ways.

noDouble.title: Never double-booked
noDouble.body: The database itself refuses two bookings on the same night. Not a promise, a rule.

instagram.title: Made for Instagram and WhatsApp
instagram.body: One link for your bio. Guests request, you confirm from your phone, they pay you directly.

ai.title: Ask your own assistant
ai.body: Connect Claude or ChatGPT to your place and ask what's booked, what's free and what you earned.

host.formSubtitle: Free during the pilot. You can add rooms right after.

channels.title: Channels
channels.intro: Keep Airbnb, Booking.com and Kazderni in step with your direct bookings. Platforms refresh on their own schedule, often every few hours.

channels.exportHint: Paste this into Airbnb and Booking.com under "Import calendar". It shows dates as taken, never guest details.
